question: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched with respect to the player and sport?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhavina Patel – Para-shooting**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bhavina Patel** is a para-table tennis player, not associated with para-shooting.
 
• **Para-shooting** is not a common para-sport, whereas para-table tennis is one of the recognized para-sports.
